svg.title: The target state of knowledge from documents, by subdomain, with the numbers overlay
svg.desc: Box 1, Ontology (core, BC-002): 2 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 8 gaps. Box 2, Extraction (core, BC-003): 2 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 8 gaps. Box 3, Knowledge graph (core, BC-004): 3 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 5 gaps. Box 4, Answering (core, BC-005): 3 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 7 gaps. Box 5, Sources and documents (supporting, BC-001): 1 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 7 gaps. Box 6, People and access (supporting, BC-006): 2 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 5 gaps. Box 7, Evaluation (supporting, BC-007): 1 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 4 gaps. Box 8, Running it (generic, BC-008): 2 capabilities, lowest stage R0, 6 gaps.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
